construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build directory

request.questions: Nonempty list of unique id/text objects with searchable terms
request.sources: List of unique id/title/text/reliability objects; reliability in [0,1]
request.profile: interests and excluded_tags string lists, nonnegative budget, integer limit 1..100
request.products: List of unique id/name/description/tags/price objects; nonnegative price

shared_schema.validation: Strict keys, types, bounds, unique identifiers, finite numbers; booleans rejected as numeric inputs. Canonical deterministic output/provenance validation at every handoff. Duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numeric constants rejected by CLI.
shared_schema.bounds: Lists at most 1000 items, strings at most 20000 characters, price/budget at most 1 billion
shared_schema.output: Same envelope with stage recommend and data containing preserved request plus research, documents, recommend
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status error and error message; CLI exits 2

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Source-linked evidence with question ID, excerpt, matching terms, supplied reliability, relevance and evidence strength
cross_stage_handoffs.validation: Documents requires a research-stage envelope and verifies it before filtering or reshaping

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Checked normalized evidence rows, per-question summaries and positively weighted discovery terms
cross_stage_handoffs.validation: Recommend requires a documents-stage envelope and verifies both upstream stages before ranking

behavior.research: Casefolded Unicode exact-token overlap ranks supplied source material for arbitrary questions, records full excerpts and unmatched questions. Strength = question-token coverage times supplied reliability.
behavior.documents: Filters below-threshold evidence, normalizes whitespace, reports counts/gaps/rejection reasons, derives a maximum strength per matched term to avoid duplicate-source inflation.
behavior.recommend: Excludes over-budget or excluded-tag products; scores 2 points per matched profile token plus document evidence term weights. Exposes components and question/source provenance. Ties sort by price then ID; zero-score candidates explicitly labeled fallback.
behavior.determinism: No random values, timestamps, external services, model calls or hidden state. Input objects are not mutated.
behavior.synthetic_data: Example and all test fixtures are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One valid JSON object; status ok; stage recommend; 2 eligible recommendations
